title: Waste-heat recovery from kiln cooling zone to dryer preheat
description: Recover 180–250 °C cooling-zone air to preheat the dryer intake, cutting natural-gas use in drying.
source: BEE UDIT — ceramics cluster case studies

title: Kiln car loading optimisation + firing curve retune
description: Raise loading density toward benchmark and shorten peak-zone dwell without quality loss.

title: Regenerative burners / recuperator on furnace
description: Preheat combustion air from flue gas; typical 15–25 % fuel saving on batch furnaces.

title: Higher in-house scrap return + charge preheating
description: Close the loop on runners/risers and preheat charge with exhaust before melting.

title: Economiser + condensate recovery on steam boiler
description: Recover flue-gas and condensate heat into feedwater; 8–15 % fuel saving.

title: Co-fire agri-residue briquettes (waste biomass) in boiler
description: Substitute a share of coal/gas with locally available agri-residue briquettes.

title: Inline moisture / density control on dryer feed
description: Tighten feed consistency to cut excess evaporation load.

title: Exhaust-air recirculation on dryer / stenter
description: Recirculate part of the hot exhaust; standard on stenters and spray dryers.

title: Ultrasonic compressed-air leak audit (routine)
description: Quarterly leak detection recovers 5–8 % of losses even in well-run systems.

title: VSD retrofit on lead compressor
description: Match compressor output to demand instead of load/unload cycling.

title: Recycle glaze overspray into base slip (closed loop)
description: Capture and reintroduce overspray instead of disposing as waste.

title: Dye-bath reuse + caustic recovery
description: Reuse dye liquor for successive batches; recover caustic from mercerising.

title: Solvent recovery still (closed loop)
description: Distil and reuse spent solvent instead of incinerating or sending to TSDF.

title: Batch consolidation on heat-treatment cycles
description: Fill furnaces to capacity per cycle; fewer, fuller cycles.

title: Waste-to-input: ETP sludge → nearby brick/block units
description: Dewatered sludge substitutes part of the raw material at nearby brick/block units.

title: Anaerobic pre-treatment with biogas capture
description: Capture methane from high-COD effluent and use it in the boiler.

title: Tertiary treatment + process water reuse
description: Reuse treated effluent for non-critical process water; cuts fresh-water pumping.
